value.name: recognizes dining room tension
value.description: She realizes that three people at the dining room table were waiting for the right question, while the fourth feared it.
evidence: three of the four people in that room had been waiting for someone to ask the right question, and the fourth had been afraid she would.

value.name: calls absorbed law firm
value.description: The next morning, she calls the firm that took over Pinsky's practice to inquire about his files.
evidence: The next morning she called the firm that had absorbed Pinsky's practice.

value.name: speaks with receptionist
value.description: A polite but harried receptionist answers and handles her inquiry.
evidence: The receptionist was polite and harried.

value.name: learns files were transferred
value.description: She is told that Mr. Pinsky's files were transferred in October.
evidence: Mr. Pinsky's files had been transferred in October, yes.

value.name: hears estate matters forwarded
value.description: She is informed that active estate matters were forwarded to executors as appropriate.
evidence: Active estate matters had been forwarded to executors as appropriate.

value.name: receives promise of callback
value.description: The receptionist says someone will look into the matter and call her back.
evidence: She would have someone look. She would call back.
